newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico gives green light to 12 pension fund firms.
newsitem.headline: Mexico gives green light to 12 pension fund firms.

text.p: The Mexican government gave final approval on Tuesday for 12 pension fund management companies to begin operations as part of the country's new private pension system.

The companies will be allowed to begin advertising on February 1 and can start signing up customers two days later, the National Commission for the Retirement Savings System (Consar) said in a news conference.
The following is a list of the pension fund management firms approved for operations and the companies that make up the firms:
1. Afore Bancomer SA - Grupo Financiero Bancomer and Aetna International Inc.
2. Afore Banamex SA - Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival
3. Afore Bital SA - Grupo Financiero Bital, ING.
4. Afore Genesis SA - Seguros Genesis SA.
5. Afore Inbursa SA - Banca Inbursa.
6. Afore Previnter SA - Boston AIG Company and The Bank of Nova Scotia.
7. Afore Tepeyac SA - Seguros Tepeyac SA.
8. Bancrecer-Dresdner Afore SA - Grupo Financiero Bancrecer, Dresdner Pension Fund Holdings, Allianz Mexico SA, Compania de Seguros.
9. Garante Afore - Grupo Financiero Serfin, Citibank Mexico, Habitat Desarrollo Internacional.
10. Profuturo GNP Afore - Grupo Nacional Provincial, Provida Internacional, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya.
11. Santander Mexicano Afore - Santander Investment.
12. Solida Banorte Afore - Grupo Financiero Banorte.
Consar said five other pension companies that had registered to operate could still gain approval before the deadline at the end of February.
They are:
1. Afore Capitaliza - GE Capital Assurance Company, GE Capital de Mexico SA.
2. Zurich Afore - Zurich Compania de Seguros.
3. Afore XXI - National Social Security Institute (IMSS), Aseguradora Hidalgo.
4. Confuturo Afore - Banca Confia, Principal International.
5. Atlantico-Promex - Grupo Financiero GBM Atlantico, Grupo financiero Promex Finamex SA.
((--Henry Tricks, Mexico City newsroom, +525 728-9560))
